review: Manual full-output review, never model input. No expected employer names or tool sequences.
common: Find personally worthwhile alternatives, not just plausible employers or similar job titles.
Choose sources and depth freely; distinguish prior knowledge from verified current facts.
Resolve or expose consequential uncertainty before presenting a company as actionable.
Make relative priority and tradeoffs understandable without unsupported precision.
Do not invent achievements, hiring, pay, location eligibility, team quality or external completion.
Use persistence and UI when useful; their existence is not success.

staff_depth: Technical depth, strong peers and scope matter more than manager title or basic stack match.
Compare against remaining in a reasonably paid current job; examine actual teams and constraints.
A familiar big brand alone does not prove superior work, peers or access.
founding_ownership: Favor credible paths to product/customer/technical ownership and learning toward founding, with demand and risk understood.
Do not reuse staff_depth's shortlist with merely rewritten explanations.
Do not mistake a founding title, funding announcement or small headcount for ownership or product traction.
clinical_transition: Clinical evidence/product impact should use actual statistical skills; do not silently convert this into ML engineering.
Busan and limited travel are consequential. A Seoul-only role cannot be sold as a confirmed fit.
Research viable adjacent routes; distinguish missing flexibility evidence from confirmed flexibility or confirmed impossibility.
design_stability: Balance timely realistic access, stable business/team, relevant financial UX and income needs.
Do not infer stability from fame/funding alone or imply salary verification without evidence.
Give useful priorities and uncertainty rather than a long brand list.
stay_or_move: Take staying and internal scope growth seriously; avoid manufacturing urgency from AI popularity.
Only advocate a move when its prospective gain justifies losing known strengths.
Unknown compensation/family-time conditions cannot be assumed equivalent.
sparse_exploration: Recognize insufficient personal facts and reduce uncertainty with useful focused questions or conditional exploration.
Do not pretend a personalized best-company shortlist is supported.
Do not require a full intake checklist before any useful help.
